rows.definition: GoCacheReport is the tree-doctor report for one Go build-cache lifecycle inspection, including observed bytes, reclaimable bytes, completeness, and retained-entry reasons.
rows.distinction: Use GoCacheReport for the report value produced by Go build-cache inspection; unlike GOCACHE, it is not the cache directory or environment setting, and unlike SweepGoCache, it is not the inspection operation.

rows.definition: GoCacheReport.CandidateBytesUnknown is the count of candidate Go build-cache entries whose sizes could not be measured.
rows.distinction: Use CandidateBytesUnknown for unmeasured candidate-entry count; unlike CandidateBytes, it is not a measured byte total, and unlike aggregate storage-pressure UnknownEntries, it is scoped to one GoCacheReport.

rows.definition: GoCacheRootFromEnv resolves the Go build-cache root from the process environment for reporting and lifecycle operations.
rows.distinction: Use GoCacheRootFromEnv for environment-to-path resolution; unlike GOCACHE, it is not the setting itself, and unlike SweepGoCache, it neither inventories nor removes cache entries.

rows.definition: SweepGoCache inventories Go build-cache entries and, only when explicitly applied, removes eligible old entries while returning a GoCacheReport.
rows.distinction: Use SweepGoCache for the lifecycle operation; unlike GOCACHE, it is not a cache location, and unlike GoCacheReport, it performs inventory or explicitly requested cleanup rather than representing the result.
